conflicts.reason: README proposes timbre/voice as a core authorization biometric. Current NIST SP 800-63B-4 permits limited biometrics only with a physical authenticator and explicitly says biometric comparison based on voice SHALL NOT be used within that guideline's authentication scope.

resolution_function_delta.resolve_jurisdiction: For biometrics/model use, resolve controller/provider/deployer, subject location, establishment/targeting, processing purpose, distribution channel and governing-license clause separately.
resolution_function_delta.resolve_authority_hierarchy: Law/regulation outranks private policy within applicable scope; NIST/ISO/RFC technical authority does not become law unless incorporated or mandated; model licenses remain private obligations distinct from public law.
resolution_function_delta.semantic_contextualize: Terms such as consent, identity, privacy, compliant, production-ready, dignity and child protection must be decomposed into legal, technical and ethical meanings before evaluation.
resolution_function_delta.cross_cultural_semantic_diff: Consent/biometrics/personality/dignity can have different legal thresholds and cultural implications; no universal equivalence or voice-consent validity is presumed.
resolution_function_delta.detect_normative_conflict: Add classes for obsolete-standard reference, private-license vs public-law duty, code-license vs model/data-license, consent-proof vs valid-consent, and standards-conformance vs certification.
resolution_function_delta.protected_subject_gate: Biometric systems involving children/vulnerable persons elevate priority but still require established subject/use/jurisdiction; do not infer subject from generic AI support.
resolution_function_delta.evidence_and_conformance_gate: Require exact algorithm/version, official current reference, KAT/vector provenance, independent tests and certification identifier where certification is claimed; for privacy require actual data-flow evidence.
resolution_function_delta.temporal_validity: Resolve obsoleted RFCs, withdrawn ISO documents and superseded NIST publications before scoring compliance.
resolution_function_delta.provenance_chain: repo@ref/path/blob_sha -> extracted claim -> current official source/version -> applicability -> test/evidence -> bounded status
